decisions.rationale: Positive engagement: praised onboarding (tick_05321ddc1246), replied on seats [email:62a57d4a], first project reached day ~2. But no teammate invited and no key milestone by day 6 despite active interest; 8 days remain, so moderate odds unaided.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Harbor Systems project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks again for the kind words about onboarding -- glad it felt smooth, and your ticket on that is now closed.

You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting some real work in there. If it would help to have a second pair of eyes, you can also invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work to walk through what you want to track first?

Best,
Priya
